thread:
sara (sec): FYI - ACME onboarding: Splunk HEC is returning 400 when we send gzip-compressed audit webhook payloads. Happened after we flipped Content-Encoding by default for webhooks.

mohit (eng): Can you paste the raw request/headers that failed?

sara (sec): Here's a minimal repro we used locally: 
```
curl -v -X POST 'https://splunk-acme.example/services/collector/event' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Splunk <token>' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -H 'Content-Encoding: gzip' \ 
  -H 'X-Audit-Schema: v3' \ 
  -H 'X-Audit-Tenant: acme-corp' \ 
  --data-binary @audit_payload.json.gz
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Body: {"text":"Malformed event - cannot parse JSON"}

elaine (platform): Splunk HEC expects newline-delimited JSON events. If we gzip the whole payload, their HEC may be trying to read line-by-line after decompression and failing on our v3 schema shape. Any sample failing event?

sara (sec): audit-bot flagged one example: 
`\{"event\":\{"actor\":\{"id\":\"u-123\",\"email\":\"user@acme.com\"\},\"request\":\{"ip\":\"10.0.0.1\"\},\"action\":\"login\"\}\}`
audit-bot: :eyes: schema-validator: v2->v3 migration: field `request.ip` was moved to `request.net.ip` and marked optional. Consumer mappings may choke if they expect `request.ip` to always exist.

kevin (cs): ACME's SIEM ingest mapping is strict; they map `request.ip` to a host field. If we removed it they'll drop the event. They claim HEC returned 400 though, so parsing or NDJSON framing fail first.

mohit (eng): Two axes to untangle: framing (NDJSON + newline delim) vs schema shape. For framing + gzip: we need to ensure we append `\n` after each event before gzipping. For schema: offer a compatibility shim for a short window.

ops-oncall: FYI - we also saw a different customer where KMS envelope key rotation caused signature verification failures for webhooks. They verify `X-Audit-Signature` against plaintext payload; if key id inside envelope rotates, the verifier must know which key id to ask for.

sara (sec): Good catch. Current signature base string is: `timestamp\ntenant_id\npayload` - it doesn't include the envelope key id. If the customer resolves the envelope separately they can't match. Proposal: include `kms_key_id` in the signature base and expose it in `X-KMS-Key-Id` header so verifiers can look up the correct public key.

mohit (eng): Proposed migration steps: 
1) Add support for `Content-Encoding: gzip` in webhook delivery with strict NDJSON framing (ensure `\n` after each event when we compress).
2) Expose `X-Audit-Schema: v3` header and accept `v2` as fallback when `X-Audit-Schema` not present.
3) Add `X-KMS-Key-Id` header and include it in the `X-Audit-Signature` base string.
4) Provide a short mapping shim: if `request.net.ip` exists but `request.ip` missing, replicate `request.net.ip` to `request.ip` for 30 days for tenants that opt-in.

elaine (platform): Implementation notes: we'll need a toggle per-tenant (console + API) to enable gzip. Don't flip globally until we've tested with a few customers. Also add a `X-Audit-Delivery-Preview: true` query param so customers can hit a preview endpoint to validate before enabling production flows.

kevin (cs): ACME wants a validation webhook we can call before turning on production. They want a sample event set + a dry-run endpoint that replies with per-event parsing/mapping result (ok/error + reason) so their Splunk team can adapt.

sara (sec): Agreed. Proposal for dry-run API: POST /audit/validate?tenant=acme-corp&schema=v3&gzipped=true -> returns array of {event_index, parsing_ok, mapping_issues:[...], actions:[suggested_shim]}

mohit (eng): Implementation checklist (short): 
- [ ] Ensure NDJSON framing pre-gzip 
- [ ] Add `X-Audit-Schema` header and accept fallback 
- [ ] Add `X-KMS-Key-Id` header and include in signature base string: `kms_key_id + '\n' + timestamp + '\n' + tenant_id + '\n' + payload`
- [ ] Dry-run endpoint + sample payloads for Splunk/Datadog/SIEM vendors 
- [ ] Docs + SDK change: sample curl for gzip+ndjson

audit-bot: Best practice reminder: include `X-Audit-Schema` and `X-Audit-Delivery-Version` headers for any breaking change. Automate compatibility scans against our vendor adapters weekly.

kevin (cs): I'll schedule a validation call with ACME Splunk team for tomorrow. Can we have dry-run endpoint + sample NDJSON gzips by EOD?

mohit (eng): I'll whip up a small patch to the delivery service and a script to emit sample gzipped ndjsons. ETA EOD for a preview build.

sara (sec): Great. Action owners: moh it -> delivery patch + preview payloads; elaine -> tenant toggle + preview endpoint; kevin -> customer validation call; sara -> update onboarding checklist and email to ACME.

ops-oncall: Note for rotations - we'll publish a short doc for customers: how to verify signatures when we rotate KMS envelope keys and where to fetch public key metadata. Include `X-KMS-Key-Id` in headers starting with the preview build.

kevin (cs): :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll post results from the Splunk call in this thread.

sara (sec): Thanks. Small note: also run the v3 schema against our Splunk adapter locally to verify no field renames will cause transform crashes (throwing instead of returning partial events).

mohit (eng): Will do. Posting sample rebuilds here when ready.
